execution: async; sequential exclusive fixture use, or a separate adapter and disposable database per pack
independence: No product imports/tests/expected values. Reviewed v0.2 documents pinned by SHA256. Canonical requirement table must match source exactly. Fixture expectations declared independently by trusted supervisor.
verdicts: Observed counterexample -> FAIL. Missing native case, port, real login, reviewed source or UI proof -> NOT_VERIFIED. All native checks and required typed proofs complete -> PASS. Historic PASS never reused.
proofs: Supervisor-owned evidence_root/<snapshot SHA>/business/FUN-XX.json. Proof has type X/R/V, immutable snapshot/contract hashes, exact file SHA256, checks=('FUN-XX:check',...), explicit passed. Product must never have write access to oracle, harness or evidence root. Parent verifies artifacts before gate.

http_binding.note: client_request_id is the UUID field fixed by brief section 5. Other DTO binding names are canonical harness/generation bindings; review logical mapping before campaign, never silently derive expected invariants from product output. Adapter performs actual login and HTTP cookie auth, no bypass/remap.

fixture_ports.prepare_case: FUN-XX plus options status,assigned,public_staff_reply,internal_reply,client_reply,disable_scenario,search_scenario,pagination_scenario. Always reset only disposable fixture DB. Return exactly five known actors and aliases alice_open/alice_second/bob_resolved.
fixture_ports.business_state: dict users/tickets/messages/ticket_events/idempotency_keys -> full ordered actual rows (not digest/null/boolean); excludes sessions only to exclude login side effects
fixture_ports.full_database_state: same actual ordered rows plus sessions; used to verify disable atomic rollback
fixture_ports.assigned_tickets: actor -> actual ticket states including closed
fixture_ports.inactive_assignments: actual join of tickets and inactive users; empty only if no invalid assignment
fixture_ports.race_connections: actual distinct SQLite connection identities for synchronized mutations
fixture_ports.set_fault: after_business_before_audit (trusted fixture callback, never debug HTTP route)
fixture_ports.restart: restart real subject server while retaining DB and harness UUID; no mocked replay
fixture_ports.fixture_metadata: search_expected q->known IDs, pagination_expected exact sorted IDs (>50), filter_expected list[(params,known IDs)], dashboard_expected actor->{total,open,in_progress,resolved,closed}; declared by fixture builder, not obtained from product queries

external_evidence.rule: Only these source/UI checks can be satisfied by supplemental artifacts. External PASS never replaces a native API/DB failure. Source proof must cite actual files/symbols and counterexample; UI proof must contain actual interactions/output.

limits: Meta-tests validate the verifier on a small real FastAPI/SQLite subject, not generated-product compliance.
Fixture PBKDF2 credentials are random and non-mocked, but this is not an Argon2/security claim; REM-15 verifies runtime product security separately.
Review/UI supplied by REM-18/19 and supervisor; missing -> NOT_VERIFIED.
No arbitrary semantic assertion weakening heuristic. Scope is the fixed business contracts only.
No paid LLM, historical snapshot edits or campaign database reset performed.
